import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

label, *command = sys.argv[1:]
destination = Path(__file__).parent
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
head_before = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
root = Path(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip())
source_files = ['scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh', 'scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py', 'humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py', 'docs/sot/verification-commands.md']
def fingerprints():
    return {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in source_files if (root / name).exists()}
before = fingerprints()
tick = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
log = destination / (label + '.log')
log.write_text(result.stdout)
record = {'command': command, 'cwd': os.getcwd(), 'started': started,
          'ended': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'elapsed': time.monotonic() - tick, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
          'session': 'hs0002-20260910', 'head_before': head_before,
          'head_after': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
          'output_file': log.name, 'output_sha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'files_before': before, 'files_after': fingerprints()}
(destination / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False))
print('DISPLAY TAIL ONLY; full output preserved in output_file:')
print(result.stdout[-1800:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)
